display.purpose: Page and document titles with compact editorial authority.

headline.purpose: Substantial local headings and empty-state anchors.

title.purpose: Task names and high-value row titles.

body.purpose: General interface copy and sustained reading.

label.purpose: Metadata, states, compact controls, and column labels.

shadows.name: ambient-low
shadows.purpose: Reserved low-level ambient token; ordinary resting sheets stay shadowless.

shadows.name: primary-action-lift
shadows.purpose: Controlled lift for the single decisive action in a region.

shadows.name: floating-layer
shadows.purpose: Menus, form overlays, and toast notices only.

motion.name: grid-reveal
motion.purpose: Restrained column-by-column entrance for headings and editorial sections.

motion.name: grid-stagger
motion.purpose: Keeps sequential structure perceptible without creating spectacle.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Completely disables reveal and state transitions when reduced motion is requested.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single decisive action within a page or editorial region.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 44px; padding: 9px 15px; color: var(--surface); font-family: var(--sans); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 650; background: var(--blue); border: 0; border-radius: 9px; box-shadow: 0 5px 14px rgba(37, 87, 214, 0.16); transition: background-color 180ms var(--ease), transform 180ms var(--ease), box-shadow 180ms var(--ease); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--blue-hover); box-shadow: 0 8px 19px rgba(37, 87, 214, 0.22); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--blue) 30%, transparent); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A compact outlined action for feedback and source operations.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 36px; padding: 6px 11px; color: var(--ink); font-family: var(--sans); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 650; background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: 7px; transition: color 180ms var(--ease), border-color 180ms var(--ease), background-color 180ms var(--ease); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { color: var(--blue); border-color: #9badde; background: var(--blue-soft); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--blue) 30%, transparent); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { background: var(--surface-active); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: The standard editable field for Briefs, sources, and forms.
components.html: <label class="ds-field-label" for="ds-brief">Brief</label><input class="ds-text-field" id="ds-brief" value="持续关注开发者工具信号" />
components.css: .ds-field-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 6px; color: var(--muted); font-family: var(--sans); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 650; } .ds-text-field { width: 100%; min-height: 44px; padding: 9px 12px; color: var(--ink); caret-color: var(--blue); background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: 8px; font-family: var(--sans); font-size: 15px; transition: border-color 180ms var(--ease), box-shadow 180ms var(--ease); } .ds-text-field:hover { border-color: #aeb5bf; } .ds-text-field:focus { outline: 0; border-color: var(--blue); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(37, 87, 214, 0.12); }

components.name: Workbench Navigation
components.description: The light editorial navigation treatment used inside the top workbench.
components.html: 任务 来源
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 3px; font-family: var(--sans); } .ds-nav-link { display: flex; min-height: 42px; align-items: center; gap: 7px; padding: 0 11px 0 13px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 14px; text-decoration: none; border-radius: 9px; transition: color 180ms var(--ease), background-color 180ms var(--ease); } .ds-nav-link svg { width: 17px; height: 17px; } .ds-nav-link path { stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.35; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: var(--ink); background: var(--surface-subtle); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--blue) 30%, transparent); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-nav-link.ds-is-current { color: var(--ink); font-weight: 650; background: var(--surface-active); }

components.name: Skill Command
components.description: Radar's signature copyable bridge from the WebUI back to the user's Agent.
components.css: .ds-skill-command { display: flex; min-height: 38px; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 0 10px; color: var(--muted); background: var(--surface-subtle); border: 0; border-radius: 8px; font-family: var(--sans); transition: color 180ms var(--ease), background-color 180ms var(--ease); cursor: pointer; } .ds-skill-command code { color: inherit; font-family: inherit; font-size: 11px; background: transparent; } .ds-skill-command span { color: var(--blue); font-size: 10px; } .ds-skill-command:hover { color: var(--blue); background: var(--blue-soft); } .ds-skill-command:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--blue) 30%, transparent); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-skill-command:active { background: var(--surface-active); }

components.name: Precision Surface
components.description: The flat, border-defined sheet used for Briefs, judgments, reports, and grouped rows.
components.html:
Brief

持续关注开发者在 AI 编程工具中反复遇到、正在变得更严重的问题。
components.css: .ds-surface { padding: 24px; color: var(--ink); background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 14px; box-shadow: none; font-family: var(--sans); } .ds-surface h3 { margin: 0 0 12px; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 680; letter-spacing: -0.015em; } .ds-surface p { max-width: 68ch; margin: 0; color: var(--muted); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.58; } .ds-surface:focus-within { border-color: var(--line-strong); }

components.name: Verified Status Chip
components.description: A compact text-bearing semantic marker for positive or selected state.
components.css: .ds-status-success { display: inline-flex; padding: 4px 8px; color: var(--success); background: var(--success-soft); border-radius: 6px; font-family: var(--sans); font-size: 10px; font-weight: 650; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Editorial Row
components.description: The aligned information row shared by task, document, report, and source lists.
components.html: Agent 重试时无法保留完整上下文多个开发者报告长期任务的上下文丢失8月26日 10:20给你看
components.css: .ds-editorial-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(260px, 1.5fr) 150px 90px; gap: 22px; min-height: 78px; align-items: center; padding: 14px 10px; color: var(--muted); border-top: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 8px; font-family: var(--sans); text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 180ms var(--ease); } .ds-row-main { min-width: 0; } .ds-row-main strong { display: block; overflow: hidden; color: var(--ink); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 650; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-row-main small { display: block; overflow: hidden; color: var(--faint); font-size: 11px; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-row-meta { font-size: 12px; } .ds-row-state { justify-self: start; padding: 4px 8px; color: var(--success); background: var(--success-soft); border-radius: 6px; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 650; } .ds-editorial-row:hover { background: var(--surface-subtle); } .ds-editorial-row:hover .ds-row-main strong { color: var(--blue); } .ds-editorial-row:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--blue) 30%, transparent); outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview:
Radar is an international signal-editing system: structured, precise, global, editorial, and restrained. Its neutral gray-white canvas, white precision workbench, graphite text, single deep-blue action color, and entirely sans-serif typography make order, alignment, and information density more important than decoration.

The top workbench keeps Agent commands and live state reachable while every page proceeds through one coherent column grid—from tasks into Briefs, sources, judgments, and reports. The first viewport establishes the title, primary action, and core task content without letting navigation consume the screen; the interface should feel like a durable editorial desk, never a promotional dashboard.
keyCharacteristics: Neutral gray-white canvas with crisp white working surfaces
One deep-blue action voice against graphite information hierarchy
Flat, border-defined structure with selective functional elevation
Restrained column-by-column reveal that yields to reduced-motion preferences

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Deep blue is the only general action color; green remains semantic, and neutral surfaces carry the rest of the hierarchy.

rules.name: The Neutral Field Rule
rules.body: Keep large areas gray-white or white so content density reads as organized information, not visual noise.

rules.name: The Sans-Only Rule
rules.body: Use the shared sans-serif stack for both Chinese and Latin; hierarchy comes from scale, weight, spacing, and alignment rather than a decorative type family.

rules.name: The One Grid Rule
rules.body: Every surface must align to the workspace and its local columns; do not create offset islands merely to add visual variety.

rules.name: The Reachable Agent Rule
rules.body: Agent commands and live sync state remain directly reachable at every viewport, including all three command paths on mobile.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Resting surfaces use borders and tonal contrast; shadows indicate action or temporary elevation, never ordinary grouping.

rules.name: The Controlled Radius Rule
rules.body: Corners communicate scale—14px for surfaces, 9px for primary controls, and smaller radii for dense metadata—without turning the interface into stacked soft shells.

dos: Do align headings, actions, rows, sheets, and metadata to one coherent editorial grid.
Do reserve deep blue for interactive intent and green for explicit success or selected semantics.
Do keep resting surfaces flat with 1px boundaries and use elevation only for primary action or temporary floating layers.
Do preserve all three Agent Skill paths plus “复制” in the compact mobile workbench.
Do disable reveal motion completely for reduced-motion users and keep state meaning available in text.
donts: Don't introduce a dark oversized side island, mint green palette, or competing accent colors.
Don't stack double soft shells, heavy shadows, excessive rounding, or generic pills around ordinary content.
Don't use offset Bento compositions or decorative asymmetry that breaks the shared column grid.
Don't let decoration, motion, or navigation displace the first viewport's title, primary action, and core task content.
Don't use serif display typography or ornament that makes the product feel promotional, low-grade, or visually noisy.
